title: 1 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 John 1: what the writers heard and saw, God as light, and the confession of sins.

questions.text: Concerning what does verse 1 say they have heard, seen and touched?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 speaks of that which was from the beginning, which they heard, saw with their eyes and touched with their hands, concerning the Word of life.

questions.text: What does verse 2 say was revealed and declared to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says the life was revealed, and we declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father.

questions.text: Why do they declare what they have seen and heard?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they declare it so that you also may have fellowship with us.

answers.text: So that the nations may fear
So that the law may be kept
So that others may have fellowship with them
So that the letter may be read aloud

questions.text: With whom does verse 3 say their fellowship is?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

answers.text: With the Father and with his Son

questions.text: Why do they write these things, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

answers.text: That their names may be known
That their joy may be fulfilled
That the world may be afraid

questions.text: What is the message they heard from him and announce?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: this is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

questions.text: What is true of those who claim fellowship with him while walking in the darkness?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that if we say we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don't tell the truth.

answers.text: They lie and do not tell the truth

questions.text: What cleanses from all sin if they walk in the light?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that if we walk in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

questions.text: What is he if they confess their sins, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that if we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

questions.text: What do they do if they say that they have not sinned?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that if we say we haven't sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
